plan.description: Create project plan using orchestrator agent
plan.instruction: Act as the orchestrator agent. Break down the task into phases: Analysis → Planning → Solution Design → Implementation. Create a detailed plan with dependencies. Do NOT write code in the planning phase.

review.description: Review code for quality, security, and performance
review.instruction: Act as the code-reviewer agent. Check: 1) Correctness 2) Security (OWASP Top 10) 3) Performance (N+1, async misuse) 4) Maintainability (SRP, DRY) 5) Testing coverage. For C#: check sealed, CancellationToken, NRT, record types.

test.description: Generate or run tests using TDD workflow
test.instruction: Act as the test-engineer agent. Follow TDD: RED (write failing test) → GREEN (minimal code to pass) → REFACTOR (clean up). Use xUnit for C#, Vitest for TypeScript, pytest for Python.

debug.instruction: Act as the debugger agent. Phase 1: OBSERVE (reproduce, read errors). Phase 2: HYPOTHESIZE (2-3 theories). Phase 3: TEST (verify most likely). Phase 4: FIX & VERIFY (minimal fix + test).

security.instruction: Act as the security-auditor agent. Scan for: injection, broken auth, sensitive data exposure, XXE, broken access control, misconfig, XSS, insecure deserialization, known vulnerabilities, insufficient logging.

dotnet.instruction: Act as the backend-specialist agent with dotnet-patterns skill. Use sealed classes, records for DTOs, CancellationToken in async, Options Pattern, Result Pattern. Follow Clean Architecture.
